evals.name: map-symbol-callers
evals.prompt: I don't know this area of code well. Go up a layer of abstraction around SessionService in /repo/src/auth/session.ts and give me a map of the relevant modules and callers before we edit it.
evals.expected_output: Produces a responsibility-grouped map with target owner, upstream callers, downstream dependencies, boundaries, evidence, uncertainty labels, and next reads.

assertions.text: Output includes a one-layer map rather than a line-by-line explanation
Output distinguishes verified caller paths from textual search leads

evals.name: ambiguous-monorepo-target
evals.prompt: Zoom out on the Order module in this monorepo. There are frontend, API, worker, and shared packages, and I only know the product term 'order cancellation'.
evals.expected_output: Starts by finding concrete handles and package boundaries, searches routes/jobs/tests/schema names, narrows to center files, and asks one concise scope question only if the target cannot be inferred.

assertions.text: Output checks workspace/package boundaries before reading every matching file
Output avoids presenting same-name matches across domains as the same subsystem without evidence

evals.name: not-generic-explanation
evals.prompt: Can you explain what a closure is in JavaScript? I don't have a repository; I just need the concept.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger zoom-out behavior, does not invent modules or callers, and answers as a general programming explanation or routes to a teaching skill.

assertions.text: Does not produce a repository module map
Does not claim caller paths without repository evidence

evals.name: loads-caller-mapping-reference
evals.prompt: Who calls PaymentIntentBuilder? I need to know the caller chain, but I only trust verified paths, not random grep hits.
evals.expected_output: Reads the caller mapping reference, ranks evidence by runtime wiring/direct invocation/tests/exports/textual matches, and labels each path as verified, likely, lead, or unknown.

assertions.text: Response uses evidence labels for caller relationships

evals.name: output-contract-map
evals.prompt: Give me a concise architecture map around the nightlyBillingJob. I need the entrypoints, downstream dependencies, unknowns, and the next three files to read.
evals.expected_output: Uses the output contract with Target, One-Layer Map, Caller Paths, Boundaries, Evidence, Unknowns, and Next Reads, keeping the result concise.

assertions.text: Agent reads references/output-contract.md or uses templates/zoom-out-map.md
Output ends with an ordered next-read list
